title: totalfloat history show --json, and history init --json
description: One changeset in a history store (ARCHITECTURE.md, History and changesets): what it is, who made it and why, its commands, what was skipped, its schedule impact, and the file it produced.

id.description: SHA-256 of the changeset's contents, except its state.

short_id.description: The first ten digits of the ID, as the log shows it.

parent.description: The changeset it follows; null for the first import.

second_parent.description: For a merge, the other branch's head.

message.description: Why, in the author's words. May be empty.

summary.description: One line for what it did, from its commands, in plain words: its title when it has no message.

created.description: When it was recorded, in UTC as RFC 3339.

tool_version.description: The TotalFloat version that recorded it.

refs.description: Branches, baselines and proposals naming it.

commands.description: For an edit, a totalfloat.command/1 document; for an import, {"import": {"file": …}}; for a revert, {"reverts": ID}.

skipped.description: Edits skipped with --skip-failed, as totalfloat.error/1 problems.

report.description: The schedule impact: for an edit, its totalfloat.edit/1 report; for an import, its projects.

snapshot.description: SHA-256 of the file it produced.

reviews.description: Decisions on it, oldest first: who accepted or rejected it, when and why.
